capabilities: Search Iconoir icon names via an && suggestion interface
Insert icon components into notes using a custom syntax
Style icons with custom CSS classes
Add icons inside headings, lists, tables and callout-styled blocks
extras: README notes the Iconoir copyright and MIT license, and warns that pipe characters in icons inside Markdown tables must be escaped with a backslash. Installation steps cover both community plugin and manual install.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to insert or style Iconoir SVG icons inside note content such as headings, lists, tables and callouts.
summary: Icon set plugin that inserts and displays customized Iconoir SVG icons in notes via an && autocomplete trigger.
